rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, proj_sr=0.0005, img_sx=0.5, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-11, ONE-KNOB change vs the iter-8 PEAK base (SSIM 0.9747, PSNR 38.63 dB; proj_n_bf=1, proj_sr=0.0005, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, n_iter=300). KNOB: image-domain BF SPATIAL sigma_x img_sx 1.5 -> 0.5 (tighten the image-domain BF spatial extent). This is a GENUINELY-UNTRIED axis on this run: the BF SPATIAL sigmas (img_sx/img_sy/proj_sx/proj_sy) were NEVER tuned in isolation -- iter-2 swapped proj_sx+proj_sy+proj_sr ALL AT ONCE off the wrong loose base (confounded, HURT 0.9680, reverted). EVERYTHING else identical to iter-8 (warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, grad_clip=1.0, lr=5e-3, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, proj_sr=0.0005, seed=42; img_sy/proj_sx/proj_sy/img_kernel/proj_kernel at Wagner-abdomen defaults). TRAJECTORY: iter-1 0.9720; iter-2 (3 proj sigmas at once, confounded) 0.9680 HURT; iter-3 (img_sr tight) 0.9723; iter-4 (img_n_bf 1->3) 0.9732 PEAK; iter-5 (img_n_bf 3->5) 0.9729 SAT; iter-6 (img_kernel 7->9) 0.9731 FLAT; iter-7 (n_iter 300->600) 0.9732 FLAT; iter-8 (proj_sr 0.02->0.0005 ISOLATED) 0.9747 NEW PEAK +0.0015; iter-9 (proj_sr 0.0005->0.0001) 0.97475 FLAT; iter-10 (proj_n_bf 1->2) 0.97475 FLAT -- BOTH projection-domain range AND depth axes SATURATED at 0.9747. FAILURE MODE at 0.9747: the 12-18-param bilateral is at its breast FBP-bounded ceiling across all RANGE-sigma (img_sr, proj_sr), DEPTH (img_n_bf, proj_n_bf), KERNEL (img_kernel) and OPTIMIZATION (n_iter) axes; hr=0 (PSNR ~1 dB under the 39.68 dB LD-FBP baseline). The one untouched-in-isolation family is the BF SPATIAL sigmas. WHY img_sx NOW (128-view = IMAGE-domain is the lever, per mayo_campaign_state.md): on the 128-view breast substrate the campaign-state knob insight records the IMAGE-domain is the active lever (proj-domain tuning HURTS) and that 'image-domain sigma_x grew 0.5->1.08 in 2 epochs on breast iter-1 -- saturating the kernel', i.e. the loose default img_sx=1.5 lets the image BF average over a too-wide spatial neighbourhood. At the established tight-range regime (img_sr=0.0005, edge-preserving in intensity), tightening the SPATIAL extent img_sx 1.5->0.5 restricts averaging to the nearest same-tissue pixels -- the spatial-extent counterpart to the range-sigma tightening that already broke the ceiling. This isolates img_sx ONLY (img_sy left at 1.5, unlike the confounded iter-2). HYPOTHESIS: tightening the image-domain BF spatial sigma_x img_sx 1.5->0.5 makes the image BF average over a tighter same-tissue spatial neighbourhood, preserving fibroglandular structure and lifting SSIM above the 0.9747 peak. If FLAT (within +-0.0005 of 0.9747) the SPATIAL-sigma axis is ALSO exhausted, confirming the ~0.9747 12-param breast bilateral structural ceiling is saturated across RANGE, DEPTH, KERNEL, OPTIMIZATION and SPATIAL axes in BOTH domains -- the BF inductive bias approaches but cannot beat a clean 128-view FBP. WALL: step budget IDENTICAL to iter-8 (n_iter=300, val_n=16; warm <=3x200=600 + per-image 16x300=4800); iter-8 ran 457 s, far under the 1800 s sbatch wall; outer_wall_s=1500 internal guard unchanged.
